issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires ExcellenceLand to have a private List<Ride> rides attribute (and tasks reiterate that rides is private). The solution implementation declares 'public List<Ride> rides;' making the attribute public. This visibility mismatch contradicts the specification and may cause students/tests to expect a private field (with a getter) and be confused or fail reflection-based checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the 'rides' attribute in ExcellenceLand to private List<Ride> rides; (keeping the constructor and getter). Ensure the field is private and provide the public getter getRides() as specified so the implementation matches the problem statement.
